title: Three roles, one repo
description: Level doesn’t matter. We wrote down what you can bring and what you get; you decide how much you take part.

items.name: Participant
items.who: Students, bootcamp grads, career changers; 0–2 years of experience.
items.give: Your curiosity and whatever time you can spare each week.
get: Commit history on a real project
A mentor review on every PR
A Demo Day recording and a reference
items.photoAlt: Four people looking at a laptop screen together

items.name: Mentor
items.give: 2–3 hours a week: a short sync and a few PR reviews.
get: Visibility on LinkedIn and in our streams
items.photoAlt: Two people working on code together at a monitor

items.name: Idea owner
items.who: Founders, product people, anyone with a problem worth solving.
items.give: A clear problem and a short weekly product chat.
get: A team you've actually worked with
Freedom to build a product on top
items.photoAlt: A group working together on laptops at a long table
